retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic composition featuring two small silhouettes running toward a bright horizon under a starry sky with dramatic light rays and bold, stacked slab-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic landscape divided into a bright, hazy lower third and a dark, starry upper two-thirds, connected by radiating beams of light and anchored by two small running silhouettes.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouetted figures centered against a bright light source
Radiating light beams connecting the horizon to the upper atmosphere
Bold, heavy typography centered in the upper third
Contrast between the cold white ground and the warm, colorful sky
coreInvariants: Two small running silhouettes at the focal point
Radiating light rays emanating from behind clouds
Starry night sky transition in the upper section

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two small silhouettes are centered at the bottom third; the title is centered in the top third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright sun/light source at the horizon line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright horizon, follows the light rays upward to the title, and then scans the starry sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive white ground at the bottom and dark starry space at the top provide breathing room for the central drama.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and black for the upper sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale yellow for the ground and light source.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange and magenta within the cloud and ray transitions.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark sky and bright ground; moderate saturation in the atmospheric effects.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, wide slab serif with tight spacing.
letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning causing letters to nearly touch
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' and 'N' have very wide footprints
The 'S' has a compact, heavy curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A small, wide sans-serif or serif for metadata text placed above the main title.
graphicDevices: Halftone-like texture in the sky transitions

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure and geometric feel.
Provides the necessary weight and blocky serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cinematic landscape with a white snowy ground in the bottom third. In the center, place two small silhouetted figures running toward a bright sun on the horizon. Above the horizon, generate dramatic light rays piercing through clouds, transitioning into a dark indigo starry night sky at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title in the upper center using a heavy, white, stacked slab-serif font. Place a small line of metadata text in a simple serif font directly above the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the title stacked and centered?
Are the silhouettes small relative to the landscape?
Do the light rays radiate from the horizon?
Is the typography a heavy slab serif?

adjustableVariables: Color of the atmospheric glow (orange vs blue)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the light rays do not obscure the legibility of the title.
Verify the transition between the white ground and the dark sky is smooth.
Confirm the silhouettes are distinct and not lost in the light source.
recipe.reuseFormula: Atmospheric landscape + Radiating light + Small silhouettes + Heavy stacked slab-serif typography.
